description: Return the description and install snippets for a named tool or server. For tools: the description, owning server, and connection metadata. For either kind: local (stdio, via npx) install snippets for every published server, plus remote (HTTP) connection snippets when a hosted endpoint exists — for every supported client, or one client via the client parameter.

client.description: Return install snippets for this client only (both local and remote transports when available). Omit to return snippets for all supported clients.

kind.description: Whether name refers to a tool or server. Omit to auto-detect: names containing underscores are treated as tools; names containing hyphens are treated as servers.

name.description: Tool name (snake_case, e.g. "earthquake_search") or server name (kebab-case, e.g. "earthquake-mcp-server"). 1-64 characters. Exact names win; unique case-insensitive names resolve to canonical names. Use cyanheads_search_catalog to discover valid names.

name: cyanheads_describe_entry

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No tool or server with the given name exists in the catalog. `ambiguous_kind`: Name matches both a tool and a server (collision in catalog). `catalog_empty`: Catalog has not finished loading. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

result.description: The resolved entry — either a tool detail or a server detail depending on the resolved kind.

oneOf.description: A resolved tool entry — its description and the server that owns it.

description.description: Brief description of what the tool does.

endpoint.description: Owning server hosted HTTP endpoint, when available.

installNotice.description: Actionable guidance when the requested client has no compatible installation snippet.

installSnippets.description: Owning server install snippets, filtered by client when supplied.

items.description: An installation snippet for the owning server.

transport.description: Local stdio or hosted HTTP transport.

npm.description: Owning server npm package for local installation.

requiredEnvVars.description: Environment variable names required for local installation.

server.description: Server package name that owns this tool.

oneOf.description: A resolved server entry — metadata, optional hosted endpoint, and per-client install snippets.

auth.description: Auth requirement for the hosted deployment (currently always "none").

description.description: Brief description of what the server does.

endpoint.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint for the hosted deployment. Absent for local-only (stdio) servers.

installNotice.description: Actionable guidance when the requested client has no compatible installation snippet.

installSnippets.description: Install instructions: local (stdio) snippets for every server, plus remote (HTTP) snippets when an endpoint exists. Filtered to one client when input.client is set.

payload.description: Install payload (JSON fragment or CLI command).

transport.description: Transport this snippet installs — stdio (local) or http (remote).

npm.description: npm package name (e.g. "@cyanheads/arxiv-mcp-server"). Drives the local stdio snippets.

requiredEnvVars.description: Env var names the local (stdio) install requires (e.g. ["MAILCHIMP_API_KEY"]). Absent when none.

toolCount.description: Number of tools exposed by this server.

tools.description: Every tool this server exposes, each with its name and a brief description — one describe call reveals the full surface without a second lookup.

items.description: A single tool exposed by this server.

description.description: Brief description of what the tool does.

version.description: Published version captured at fleet-generation time.

title: Describe Fleet Tool or Server
